title: openGym — the GitHub repo worth saving
description:
openGym is a self-hosted gym tracker you actually own, no subscription or ads. You plan your week's workouts, run guided sessions that track every set, and log your body weight over time — all synced across your phone and laptop.

More like this → gittrend.io
